_: Idea #20 in-world skill tree — Phase 0 (JContainers JFormDB persistence, design §七 Phase 0). A trainer NPC whose 'Train your Endurance' dialogue line PERSISTS per-NPC skill state to a JFormDB storage keyed on the speaker, then SYNCS the matching perk from the stored rank. The 'Reflect on your bond' line shows the AFFINITY GATE (design §四, Sofia F6 blueprint): the bank+sync runs only once the affinity GLOB crosses a threshold, so growth can be gated on a relationship counter with no hand-written Papyrus. No Campfire / in-world UI — this is the pure-effect persistence layer ('an NPC grows perks from stored state'). ⚠ REQUIRES JContainers SE installed at runtime, and compiling the generated TIF_*.psc needs JContainers' own .psc on the Papyrus header path (main machine; see WAIT_USER). Lifecycle note: only the root-DB path API (JFormDB.solveXxxSetter/solveInt) is used, so there is no JValue.object()/retain()/release() to balance (design unknown U5 — avoided by construction). The perk here is a trivial inline PERK so the spec is self-contained; swap to your real skill-tree perks.

globals._: The affinity / relationship counter (Sofia F6 blueprint). Raise it elsewhere (gifts, quests, the dialogue line below); the gated line reads it to decide whether growth unlocks. short = integer flag/counter.

perks.name: Adaptation
perks.description: Endurance node — the bearer endures and hits a touch harder.
perks._effect: A trivial self-contained entryPoint so the perk does something when synced; swap for your real node effect.

npcs.name: Skill Trainer
npcs._: A plain NPC to host the trainer dialogue. Place/spawn it however you like; the skill state hangs on this NPC's Form via JFormDB.

quests.name: Skill Training
quests._: StartGameEnabled controller quest so the dialogue is loaded/evaluated. type=None keeps it out of the journal.

stages._: STAGE-FRAGMENT persist demo: on quest start (game load) the engine auto-runs this stage, which banks an init marker keyed on the trainer NPC's base form — an ARBITRARY-REF key (not speaker/player; bound as a Form property). A quest stage has no speaker, so the key must be 'player' or a ref.

dialogue._: On pick: bump the speaker's stored Endurance level + ratio (delta = read-add-write counters), set the Adaptation node rank to 2, then sync perks — Adaptation is added once its stored rank reaches 2.

AFFINITY GATE demo (design §四 好感度 gate, Sofia F6 blueprint): both the bank and the perk sync run only when MFSkill_TrainerAffinity >= 4. Below the threshold the line is inert; once the relationship counter is high enough the Adaptation node is set to rank 2 and the perk applies. Use 'atMost' too for a band (atLeast <= value <= atMost); omit both to gate on the GLOB being non-zero.
